# As offline_across_epochs, but Alice's traffic is held too while the epochs pass, so she cannot
# write her message again: the replicas let it go, and Bob does not read it when he is back.

create alice g
join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
hold bob
send alice g said before two epochs
run 60
hold alice
epoch
run 60
epoch
run 60
release bob
run
show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— joined the group

jobs alice g
----
rewrite to box 0, 259 bytes
rewrite to box 1, 99 bytes
rewrite to box 0, 259 bytes
rewrite to box 1, 99 bytes
